description: Search for addiction treatment and mental health facilities. Filter by US state, city, treatment type, and insurance. Returns facility names, locations, programs, insurance, phone numbers, and direct links.

city.description: City name to filter results (e.g. "Phoenix", "New York"). Case-insensitive partial match.

insurance.description: Insurance provider name to filter by (e.g. "Medicaid", "Aetna", "Blue Cross", "Medicare", "Private Insurance"). Case-insensitive partial match.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Range: 1-20, default: 5.

state.description: US state name or 2-letter abbreviation (e.g. "California" or "CA"). Filters results to facilities in this state.

treatment_type.description: Type of treatment program to filter by. Each facility may offer multiple program types.

name: search_facilities
